task: M4 Task 1 - build stock llama.cpp (CPU/AVX2) for gate-#2 baseline

toolchain.compiler_source: portable zip from github.com/mstorsjo/llvm-mingw release 20260922 (no admin, no MSVC/Visual Studio installed)
toolchain.why_not_msvc: no MSVC/Windows SDK present and shell is non-elevated; MSVC Build Tools install needs UAC (would block). Chose the lighter clang/LLVM path per brief resolution #1; llvm-mingw is self-contained (bundles clang, libc++, libunwind, libomp, mingw headers/CRT) so no Windows SDK needed.

commit.note: exact pinned commit was directly checkout-able from a full clone; no tag substitution needed
commit.cli_version_string: version: 10099 (1a064ab09) / built with Clang 23.1.2 for Windows AMD64

configure_adaptations.win32_winnt_define: -D_WIN32_WINNT=0x0A00 : REQUIRED. mingw defaults _WIN32_WINNT to Windows 7; vendored cpp-httplib (pulled into common via download.cpp/hf-cache.cpp) #errors below Windows 10 and CreateFile2 (Win8+) is hidden. Host is Windows 11, so raising it is correct and does not change llama.cpp behavior. Applied globally at the shared root so both target binaries are fixed at once.

binaries.standalone_verified: yes - both exes run with NO llvm-mingw on PATH (via copied DLLs); Task 3 can consume them directly

verification.smoke_1_token: PASS - llama-cli -m models/m1/qwen3-gguf/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Q4_K_M.gguf -p "hi" -n 1 -st -no-cnv => model loaded (build b10099-1a064ab09), prompt processed, 1 token generated, clean exit 0
verification.smoke_flag_note: brief's bare `-no-cnv` alone dropped into the refactored interactive chat-client and looped on EOF stdin (exit 253). Added `-st/--single-turn` (predefined -p prompt => non-interactive, exits when done) to get the intended 1-token decode + exit 0. Same binary, same model, decode confirmed.

tripwire.note: free disk never fell below 5 GiB (min observed 11.80 GiB), so models/m3/qwen3-repack was NOT removed

concerns: Build has a NETWORK dependency: tools/ui 'Provisioning UI assets' downloads the web UI bundle from huggingface.co at build time (llama-cli links llama-ui via llama-server-impl in this commit). First HTTP/2 attempt failed transiently; succeeded on retry. A clean rebuild offline would fail at this step.

Binary is a clang/llvm-mingw build, not MSVC. Functionally equivalent stock CPU/AVX2 llama.cpp at commit 1a064ab; compiler brand does not change the inference algorithm or the --n-cpu-moe behavior the gate measures.
